title: Lookup in a concatenation with varying lengths
statement: Let $f$ assign a list to each natural number, and let $n,r,o$ be natural numbers with $r<n$ and $o<|f(r)|$. For a default element $d$, the entry at position equal to the sum of the lengths of $f(0),\ldots,f(r-1)$ plus $o$ in the concatenation of $f(0),\ldots,f(n-1)$, with default $d$, equals the entry at position $o$ in $f(r)$ with the same default.
hypotheses_covered: A list-valued function $f$ on the natural numbers
A default element $d$ of the list type
